title: digiTREATS stepped-care program
summary:
The aim of this study is the development, implementation, and evaluation of a stepped-care program (digiTREATS) for the treatment of depression.
Through the three-level care model, which is individually tailored to the needs and symptoms of participants, the program aims to provide precise and effective support. The content focuses on education, mindfulness, physical activity, and podcasts, delivered over a period of three months.

Depending on the assigned level, participants receive close guidance from psychologists, exercise scientists, social workers, and peers. The project is led by psychiatrists in senior positions at BKH Augsburg. Regardless of the assigned level, all participants receive five scheduled consultations with the case management team (at baseline, and after 2, 6, 10, and 12 weeks). All interactions—both individual and group sessions—take place in digital format.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inpatient, day-care, or outpatient treatment at the Bezirkskrankenhaus Augsburg
Participation in the DEPRESS cohort
Depressive symptoms at the T0 visit, measured with the PHQ-9 and a score of ≥ 5
Age ≥ 18 years
Capacity to provide informed consent
Sufficient language proficiency to understand the implications of participation in digiTREATS
Ability to participate in online activities via smartphone, computer, or tablet
Internet access
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of capacity to provide informed consent
Presence of acute suicidality
